answer: More aliases means more devices and more keys, each with its own mesa proof, and each must still clear the summit grading gate to earn. The gale counter resets at epoch open, which makes the throughput ceiling permanent rather than something a patient attacker can outlast. Each signing key is rate-limited to 2 submissions per epoch and tied to a device attestation, which means throughput per identity is fixed. That is 24 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
